mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (id, order_no, product_no, content, rating) VALUES (#{id},#{orderNo},#{productNo},#{content},#{rating})
mapper.select: SELECT r.review_no, r.id, r.order_no, r.product_no, r.created_at, r.modified_at, r.rating, p.product_name, p.img_url FROM review r LEFT JOIN product_all p ON r.product_no = p.product_no ORDER BY r.review_no DESC;
